js: window.__until = async (f, ms) => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (;;) { try { if (f()) return true; } catch {} if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) return false; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } }

name: prepared-at-idle-not-playing
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.playing === false && s.live === false && (s.mode !== 'hls' || s.hls === true); }, 20000)

name: prepared
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return { mode: s.mode, hls: s.hls, events: s.events }; })()

name: playback
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return { mode: s.mode, readyState: s.readyState, videoWidth: s.videoWidth, currentTime: s.currentTime, level: s.level, error: s.error, events: s.events.filter((e) => !/Frag/.test(e)) }; })()

name: frames-advance
js: (async function(){ const a = window.__hologram.status().currentTime; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const s = window.__hologram.status(); window.__holoDelta = s.currentTime - a; return s.paused === false && window.__holoDelta > 0.5; })()

name: playback-after-switch
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return { mode: s.mode, readyState: s.readyState, currentTime: s.currentTime, level: s.level, error: s.error }; })()

name: second-click-cinema
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__hologram.status(); const v = document.querySelector('video.holo-video'); return s.cinema === true && s.muted === false && s.controls === true && v.classList.contains('cinema') && (document.fullscreenElement === v || v.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth - 2); }, 10000)

name: cinema
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return { cinema: s.cinema, fullscreen: s.fullscreen, fsTag: document.fullscreenElement && document.fullscreenElement.tagName, muted: s.muted, controls: s.controls, paused: s.paused, currentTime: s.currentTime, tail: s.events.slice(-4) }; })()

name: cinema-frames-advance
js: (async function(){ const a = window.__hologram.status().currentTime; return window.__until(() => window.__hologram.status().currentTime - a > 0.4, 15000); })()

name: escape-returns-to-hologram
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__hologram.status(); return s.cinema === false && document.fullscreenElement === null && s.muted === true && s.controls === false && s.paused === false && window.__hologram.focused === true && window.__table.state.focused === 'hologram' && window.__hologram.screenVisible === true && window.__hologram.screenOpacity > 0.9; }, 10000)

name: after-escape
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return { cinema: s.cinema, focused: window.__table.state.focused, muted: s.muted, paused: s.paused, tail: s.events.slice(-4) }; })()

name: button-does-the-same
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__hologram.status(); const v = document.querySelector('video.holo-video'); return s.cinema === true && s.muted === false && (document.fullscreenElement === v || v.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth - 2); }, 10000)

name: released-on-exit
js: (function(){ const s = window.__hologram.status(); return window.__hologram.screenVisible === false && s.playing === false && s.cinema === false && s.readyState === 0; })()
